name: R&D SINGLE LaTeX MANUSCRIPT TOWER

conventions.core_namespace: RD-LTX-CORE-001 through RD-LTX-CORE-100, assigned only when actual rules implemented
conventions.numbering_note: The 1-100 then 101 numbering is a namespace convention, not proof that one hundred format requirements are implemented. PU-FMT-001..PU-FMT-145 is a separate authority ID space.

no_duplication: No researcher maintains a copy or fork of the global LaTeX template
Each researcher consumes the SAME current canonical tower and shared pumlsc-shared.sty
Researcher JSON is a parameter/metadata profile and optional explicit extensions, never a second tower
The legacy controls/latex.control.json is a routing alias only
Historical controls/projects/safal-dawadi.latex.json is a compatibility evidence profile only; no formatting code or global rules originate there
change_flow: Record PDF defect and reproducible source/before-after evidence in researcher QA trace (private Drive when required)
Add proposed change to the ONE central change-register.json with next ID >= 101
Classify as GLOBAL_CANDIDATE or RESEARCHER_ONLY and cite affected researcher, cause, rule IDs, source file(s) and evidence
For GLOBAL: edit the SINGLE shared .sty/template, update core rule/revision, run validation and all available researcher regression gates; production visual checks remain required
For RESEARCHER_ONLY: register explicit owner and reason in extension-registry.json, store only the small delta in allowed researcher extensions path; no copied base template
If a formerly local fix is universally applicable, promote its implementation to the canonical shared template and mark the local amendment superseded; never create independent permanent base copies
Commit Git change and provider readback; scientific approval and final PDF release separate
bibliography: Explicit project selection; NO global default
source_authority: Drive PU v1.13 approved format remains external historical/academic source until complete parity, not another Git operational tower
drive_role: University originals, source evidence, compiled PDFs, A9 private registries (no active Git tower clone)
release_scope: historical versioned ref; main is latest operational control; versioned Git refs are not parallel towers
public_source_safety: Do not import licensed Times New Roman files, private evidence, photographs, scientific data or compiled PDFs
